summary: The Privacy-Preserving Data Engineer builds data pipelines and platforms that maintain compliance, anonymity, and confidentiality using advanced privacy techniques.
responsibilities: Implement data anonymization, encryption, and differential privacy techniques
Ensure compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and other regulations
Design secure pipelines for analytics, ML, and AI workflows
Collaborate with legal, compliance, and engineering teams
Monitor and audit privacy-preserving measures in data systems

education: 4–8 years of experience in secure data engineering and compliance

skills_required.name: Knowledge of privacy-preserving technologies (differential privacy, federated
Strong programming in Python, Scala, or Java
Cloud and distributed data platform experience
